comment: Helms made the content digestible, and there was nothing surprising on the exams. Practice in-class problems and homework, and you're bound to do well. Low stakes hw and short quizzes. Labs are for completion. Take her if you can!!

I would recommend Dr. Helms for this higher-level physics class! She explains the material well and is always open to questions. Homework feels a little off coming straight from the textbook, but the notes have more of an emphasis in the class.
Dr. Helms taught this class well. I appreciated the many examples we did in class. As long as you understand the homework, tests should go well.

This class was very interesting, and Dr. Helms is a great lecturer. Test questions are sometimes touch and go, and the research papers take some time to understand, so it's important to understand the concepts. Overall, a good physics elective, and I'd recommend to those interested in biology and math.

Dr. Helms is an amazing professor. She is very clear in her lectures and does not make an already hard subject even harder than it needs to be. Homework is sometimes difficult but graded mostly for completion and prepares you for the quizzes and exams which are more straightforward. Highly recommend her for any physics class!

Her exams are really straightforward, and I really enjoyed being in her course. It makes the content really manageable. But sometimes her grading is inconsistent. I still think she is pretty good as a PHYS 132 professor!
Would not take again. Takes off a lot of points to ruin grades

Dr. Helms makes a tough subject much more manageable. Her exams are not hard, but she is sometimes stingy and inconsistent with grading. She gives quizzes shortly after learning material which is sometimes rough. Lab and homework are graded for completion. Always willing to help outside of class. Definitely recommend.

I really like Dr. Helms because she gives great notes for studying outside of class. Her grading criteria are very clear. Her homework gives us good practices on the material learned. The difficulty of the quizzes and exams are just perfect. If you study the notes, you will be fine!
Really caring professor. I was horrible at physics and I still walked out with a B somehow. She does sometimes have trouble answering questions but other than that, she's pretty good.
She is very kind and helpful, probably the easiest in Physics department.
